verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense ships AI features such as the Invoice Coding Agent and AI-powered spend management, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or consume external MCP servers. The only MCP evidence is BILL's own documentation MCP server, which lets outside tools like Cursor and Claude Desktop query BILL docs. That is the server role and cannot be credited to this client-side story.
